critical_changes: Medi-Cal undocumented adults (Jan 1 2026): New applicants 19+ get restricted scope only. Existing enrollees keep full-scope if they renew on time.
CalFresh work requirements (June 1 2026): Adults 18-64 without children under 14 must meet 20+ hrs/week. 525,000+ affected.
CalFresh non-citizen eligibility (April 1 2026): Asylees, refugees, parolees lose CalFresh unless LPR. Surface CFAP as alternative.
Medi-Cal work requirements (January 2027): ACA expansion adults face work requirements at renewal. ~4.9 million affected.
